reading.title: My Mum's Office
reading.text: My mum works in an office in the city. It is a big office building with a green door. She is a secretary, and she answers the phone and writes letters for the manager. The manager is a kind man called Mr Aliyev. Mum goes to the office at eight o'clock and finishes at five. Sometimes she has a meeting with the manager. At the weekend she does not go to the office, and we go to the park.

listening.title: A Day at the Hotel
listening.script: Dilnoza is the manager of a small hotel. She has an office on the ground floor. Every morning she has a meeting with her secretary, Anvar. He answers the phone and books rooms for the guests. Yesterday a family called to ask about a room. Anvar told them the price, and they were happy. After work, Dilnoza closes the office and goes home.

reading.title: The Factory in Our Town
reading.text: There is a bread factory in our town. It is the biggest employer here, and about three hundred people work in the factory. My neighbour is a factory worker. He starts at six o'clock in the morning. The factory is a good employer because it pays well and gives holidays to its employees. Last month it hired ten new employees. My brother wants to find employment there after school.

listening.title: Closing Day
listening.script: Last year the toy factory in our city closed. It was the largest employer in the area, so many employees lost their jobs. My aunt was one of them. She looked for employment for three months. At last, a shop hired her as a full-time employee. Now she works there from Monday to Friday. She says the new employer is very kind.

reading.title: A Lost Bicycle
reading.text: Yesterday my bicycle was gone from the front of our house. I was very sad. Dad said, "Let's report it to the police." We walked to the police station near the park. A friendly police officer wrote down the colour and the place. He said, "The police are looking for it. We will call you." Two days later the police called us. They found the bicycle in a garden and brought it back in a police car.

listening.title: Police Day at School
listening.script: Today a police officer visited our school. He talked about road safety. He said, "If you see danger, call the police." Then a police dog came into the hall. The dog was big, but it was very kind. The officer told us how the police dog finds lost things. At the end, we asked questions. I asked how he joined the police, and he said he studied hard.

reading.title: A Brave Grandfather
reading.text: My grandfather was a soldier in the army when he was young. He was brave, and he helped many people. Now he is a retired soldier and lives with us. He keeps his old uniform in a box. Every year on Victory Day we watch the soldiers in the parade. Grandfather stands very straight and smiles. He says, "A good soldier is always kind."

listening.title: The Parade
listening.script: On Saturday there was a big parade in the main square. We stood near the front. First, a band played loud music. Then the soldiers marched past us in green uniform. They walked in a straight line, and their boots all sounded the same. A young soldier smiled at me. My little brother waved a small flag. After the parade, we bought ice cream.

reading.title: A Day in the City
reading.text: Last Sunday our class went on a trip to the city. In the morning we visited a history museum. The guide showed us old coins and swords. After lunch we went to an art gallery. There was a big painting of a mountain. In the evening some of us went to the theatre to see a play, but my family went to the cinema. The cinema tickets were cheap, and the film was funny.

reading.text: Our class is going to put on a play at school. The play is about a brave king and a clever girl. I am an actor in the play, and I am the king!
